critical_code_review_comments: POST /storefront/{username}/follow uses len(followers)+/-1 from the pre-update snapshot rather than re-fetching after $addToSet/$pull. Idempotent because $addToSet/$pull dedupe at Mongo level, but if the same viewer somehow hits the endpoint twice in flight (race), the returned follower_count could drift by 1 from reality. Low risk — frontend always reconciles via /follow-status on the next page load.

DELETE /api/products/{id} soft-deletes by setting status='deleted'. Confirmed the public storefront filter excludes it. Recommend an admin recovery endpoint (PATCH status back to 'approved') or it becomes write-only data over time. Not blocking.

Backend startup ran 'index ensure failed on users (users_email_unique)' 3 times BEFORE the duplicate cleanup (visible in earlier err.log lines around 09:10) — latest two boots are clean. Re-running ensure on every startup is fine; just noting the warnings in older log lines are stale.
/admin/sitemap currently renders 42 tiles. The review request mentioned '7 sections' and that was confirmed (Core/Score/Commerce/Community/Ambassador/Admin/Owner).
